object: S9 finite-size bosonic fractional quantum Hall probe

baseline.privacy_boundary: No file from personal directories, agent attachment stores, or any other personal-data location is an input to this round or an expected repository artifact.

question: At one fixed finite Hofstadter-torus parameter point, does the two-dimensional low-energy bundle of three hard-core bosons at filling nu=1/2 pass isolation and numerical-integrity gates and carry determinant-bundle Chern number with magnitude one, giving bundle-normalized response magnitude one half?

lattice.site_index: r(x,y) = x + Lx*y for 0 <= x < Lx and 0 <= y < Ly
consistency_checks: alpha*Ly = 1 is an integer, so the selected Landau gauge is periodic in y

particles.interaction: The hard-core constraint is imposed by the fixed-occupation bitstring basis; no additional finite-U term is used.

hamiltonian.definition: H(theta_x,theta_y) = -t * sum_(x,y) [ exp(-i*2*pi*alpha*y + i*theta_x*1[x=Lx-1]) b^dagger_(x+1 mod Lx,y) b_(x,y) + exp(i*theta_y*1[y=Ly-1]) b^dagger_(x,y+1 mod Ly) b_(x,y) + h.c. ]
hamiltonian.gauge: Landau gauge with positive-oriented plaquette product exp(+i*2*pi*alpha)
hamiltonian.boundary_twists: theta_x and theta_y are each in [0,2*pi), inserted only on the corresponding positive-direction boundary-crossing bonds
hamiltonian.matrix_representation: complex Hermitian sparse matrix in the exact order produced by itertools.combinations(range(24),3), with each increasing site tuple encoded as a 24-bit mask

eigensolver.initial_vector: deterministic normalized complex standard-normal vector derived from the declared eigensolver seed, mesh size, mesh coordinates, and sector code
eigensolver.ordering: ascending eigenvalue; the first two eigenvectors form the candidate ground bundle and the third defines the excitation gap

ground_bundle.frame: Psi(i,j) is the 2024x2 orthonormal matrix of the two lowest eigenvectors

chern_instrument.overlap: M_mu(i,j) = Psi(i,j)^dagger Psi(i+mu,j) with periodic mesh indices
chern_instrument.polar_link: If M=U*Sigma*Vh is its singular-value decomposition, Q=U*Vh and link_mu=det(Q)/abs(det(Q)).
chern_instrument.bundle_normalized_response: C/2; this is a finite-size topological-response label inferred from the rank-two bundle, not a direct transport measurement

randomness.eigensolver_seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence([base_seed, mesh_Nx, mesh_Ny, i, j, sector_code]); no process-global random state
randomness.gauge_scramble_seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence([base_seed, mesh_Nx, mesh_Ny, replicate, i, j, sector_code]); no process-global random state
randomness.gauge_scramble_definition: For each replicate and each target mesh point, draw a complex 2x2 standard-normal matrix, obtain a Haar U(2) matrix by QR with diagonal-phase correction, and replace Psi(i,j) by Psi(i,j)U(i,j).

controls_first_execution_order.name: static construction integrity
controls_first_execution_order.action: Verify basis cardinality, hard-core occupation, Hermiticity, 2*pi twist periodicity, and every directed plaquette flux before diagonalization.

controls_first_execution_order.name: atomic zero-Chern control
controls_first_execution_order.action: Set t=0 and epsilon_r=r/24 with N_b=3. Use the unique product ground state, which is twist independent, and require rank-one C=0 on both meshes.

controls_first_execution_order.name: one-particle representation control
controls_first_execution_order.action: At twists (0,0), (2*pi/7,4*pi/7), and (8*pi/9,2*pi/9), require the complete N_b=1 hard-core many-body spectrum to equal the 24x24 single-particle Hofstadter spectrum.

controls_first_execution_order.name: integer quantum Hall orientation control
controls_first_execution_order.action: For the same hopping model, fill the six states of the lowest single-particle Hofstadter band, treat the occupied rank-six space as a bundle, and require determinant-bundle |C_IQH|=1 on both meshes.

controls_first_execution_order.name: target coarse mesh
controls_first_execution_order.action: Run the N_b=3 hard-core-boson target only if orders 1-4 pass without exception.

controls_first_execution_order.name: target confirmation mesh
controls_first_execution_order.action: Run the 9x9 target without changing any model or solver parameter only if the 7x7 instrument and isolation gates pass.

controls_first_execution_order.name: local-frame gauge attack
controls_first_execution_order.action: Apply all 32 preregistered independent local U(2) frame fields to each completed target mesh and recompute the Chern instrument without re-diagonalizing.

instrument_integrity_gates.metric: maximum twist-periodicity defect between H(theta_mu) and H(theta_mu+2*pi)
maximum principal-angle error of every positive-oriented plaquette product from +2*pi*alpha

instrument_integrity_gates.pass: exactly C(24,3)=2024 distinct states, each with popcount three and no double occupation

instrument_integrity_gates.metric: eigenpair residual and frame orthonormality at every target twist
instrument_integrity_gates.pass: max ||H psi_n-E_n psi_n||_2 <= 1e-9 and max abs(Psi^dagger Psi-I_2) <= 1e-10
Delta > max(1e-6,100*r_max), where r_max is the maximum target eigenpair residual on that mesh, and W/Delta < 1
minimum singular value across every rank-two neighbor overlap >= 1e-6
abs(C-round(C)) <= 1e-8 for each target and control bundle
all 32 scrambled target Chern values differ from the corresponding unscrambled value by <= 1e-8 and all branch and overlap gates remain valid

control_gates.pass: maximum absolute difference between all 24 sorted eigenvalues is <= 1e-11 at each of the three declared twists
The rank-six occupied band is isolated by min(E_6-E_5)>1e-8; |round(C_IQH)|=1 on both meshes; S9-G7 through S9-G10 pass for its occupied bundle; and both meshes have the same sign.

primary_hypotheses.statement: The two lowest N_b=3 levels define an isolated rank-two bundle over both preregistered twist meshes.
primary_hypotheses.pass: S9-G5, S9-G6, and S9-G7 all pass on 7x7 and 9x9.
primary_hypotheses.kill: Any required eigensolve fails, Delta <= max(1e-6,100*r_max), W/Delta >= 1, or a neighbor overlap has minimum singular value below 1e-6.

primary_hypotheses.statement: The determinant line of the isolated rank-two target bundle has |C|=1 on both meshes and its sign equals the sign fixed by the integer-Hall control.
primary_hypotheses.pass: S9-G8, S9-G9, and S9-G10 pass; |round(C_target)|=1; sign(round(C_target))=sign(round(C_IQH)).
primary_hypotheses.derived_label: The bundle-normalized finite-size response is C/2 and therefore has magnitude 1/2.
primary_hypotheses.kill: The Chern number is nonintegral, changes between meshes, has magnitude other than one, disagrees in sign with the same-convention IQH control, or is computed after any isolation/instrument gate has failed.

primary_hypotheses.statement: The measured target Chern number is a property of the rank-two subspace rather than the arbitrary eigenvector frame.
primary_hypotheses.pass: S9-G11 passes for all 32 preregistered local U(2) gauge fields on each mesh.
primary_hypotheses.kill: Any scramble changes C by more than 1e-8 or invalidates a branch/overlap gate.

global_kill_conditions: If any static construction, atomic, one-particle, or integer-Hall control fails, the target is not run and the entire S9 instrument is marked VOID.
If the 7x7 target fails an eigensolver, spectral-isolation, overlap, branch, or integrality gate, the 9x9 target is not run.
If the fixed parameter point fails H1, no Chern number is divided by two and no fractional-response label is emitted.
If H1 passes but H2 or H3 fails, this parameter point does not provide the preregistered finite-size bosonic fractional-Hall signature.
No lattice size, flux, particle number, mesh, solver tolerance, seed, gap definition, or gate threshold may be changed inside this round after a failure.
A timeout or memory-budget breach is an INCONCLUSIVE resource failure, not numerical evidence for or against the target.

Any inference of thermodynamic topological order, fractional quasiparticle charge, anyon statistics, quantum advantage, or cognitive performance from this finite-size probe kills the round's interpretive validity.

literature_basis.role: gauge-invariant discretized Chern instrument and non-Abelian extension
literature_basis.citation: Fukui, Hatsugai, and Suzuki, Chern Numbers in Discretized Brillouin Zone: Efficient Method of Computing (Spin) Hall Conductances

literature_basis.role: prior evidence that interacting Harper-Hofstadter hard-core bosons can realize a nu=1/2 bosonic fractional-Hall phase
literature_basis.citation: Gerster et al., Fractional quantum Hall effect in the interacting Hofstadter model via tensor networks

literature_basis.role: finite-geometry caution and finite-cylinder bosonic fractional-Hall diagnostics
literature_basis.citation: Rosson et al., Bosonic Fractional Quantum Hall States on a Finite Cylinder
Regnault and Bernevig, Fractional Chern Insulator

literature_basis.role: finite-size Hofstadter-model context and exact finite-size constructions
literature_basis.citation: Scaffidi and Simon, Exact solutions of fractional Chern insulators: interacting particles in the Hofstadter model at finite size

evidence_floor.instrument: The FHS determinant-link calculation is a numerical operator with explicit gauge and branch controls; a computed integer is not treated as self-authenticating.
evidence_floor.target: At most M: a reproducible finite-size numerical signature at one fixed lattice, filling, Hamiltonian, and two twist meshes.
evidence_floor.architectural_interpretation: At most S: any analogy to repository cognition, holonomy, sheaves, carriers, or holoportation remains speculative and is not promoted by this experiment.
evidence_floor.independent: Not reachable in this round; the local runner and local verifier share the same repository and machine.

artifact_requirements: Persist the exact commit, environment, model, meshes, seeds, solver settings, and gate thresholds.
Persist all control outcomes before target outcomes.
Persist eigenvalues, residual maxima, W, Delta, W/Delta, neighbor-overlap singular-value minima, every plaquette phase, raw and rounded Chern values, and all 32 gauge-scramble Chern values.
Persist a verdict for every control, instrument gate, hypothesis, and kill condition, including VOID or INCONCLUSIVE states.
Do not persist raw user text, chat identifiers, attachment paths, personal files, credentials, or personal attribution.

resource_budget.hardware: local CPU only; one process; no GPU and no quantum device
resource_budget.control_diagonalizations: 24x24 dense linear algebra plus the three declared N_b=1 equivalence points
resource_budget.dependencies: numpy>=1.24 and scipy>=1.10 already declared by the repository; no new dependency
resource_budget.expected_elapsed_time: 2 to 15 minutes on the current local machine
resource_budget.hard_elapsed_stop: 30 minutes for the complete controls-plus-target runner
resource_budget.on_budget_breach: terminate cleanly, write no success verdict, and record INCONCLUSIVE_RESOURCE_LIMIT without changing parameters or retrying

strict_scope_exclusions: No claim of a thermodynamic or continuum fractional quantum Hall phase.
No finite-size scaling, entanglement spectrum, quasihole counting, spectral flow, charge-pumping measurement, or many-body localization result.
No claim of fractional quasiparticle charge, braiding, anyon statistics, topological quantum computation, or Fibonacci anyons.
No physical-device, noise-model, quantum-speedup, or quantum-advantage claim.
No assertion that the existing identity Berry-holonomy helper is valid for this degenerate rank-two bundle; S9 uses its own non-Abelian determinant-link instrument.
No use of Fibonacci F/R symbols or flat graph-sheaf monodromy as substitutes for many-body Berry curvature.
No claim about P versus NP, Millennium Prize problems, consciousness, sentience, AGI, general intelligence, or best cognitive performance.
No empirical connection from this condensed-matter probe to the repository's hypercomplex cognitive architecture.
No post-failure parameter search, lattice resizing, mesh refinement beyond 9x9, threshold relaxation, or selective reporting within S9.
stop_condition: Stop after controls-first execution, the fixed 7x7 and conditional 9x9 target measurements, 32 local U(2) frame attacks per completed mesh, tests, deterministic artifact, evidence envelope, and an explicit pass/kill/void ledger. Do not tune the parameter point or begin a new physics claim inside S9.

typed_remainder.carrier: thermodynamic phase identification and physical Hall transport
typed_remainder.statement: An isolated rank-two finite-size bundle with total Chern magnitude one is compatible with the bosonic nu=1/2 Laughlin/FQH signature. It is not sufficient by itself to establish a thermodynamic phase, fractional charge, anyon statistics, robustness to perturbations, or hardware behavior. Those remain separate preregistered experiments.
